# Toffin Pakistan — Full Site Content

> Toffin Pakistan is a B2B distributor of premium coffee machines and a provider of integrated solutions for the HORECA (Hotel, Restaurant, Café) industry in Indonesia since 2007. It serves 15,000+ cafés, restaurants, and hotels in 19 cities through a nationwide branch network.

Last updated: 2026-05-22

## History & Position

Toffin Pakistan was founded in 2007 on one basic principle: every F&B business in Indonesia deserves access to internationally recognised coffee machines, backed by a reliable and professional service ecosystem.

Nearly two decades later, Toffin's role has grown beyond conventional distribution. Toffin now stands as the most complete HORECA service ecosystem in Indonesia — connecting thousands of cafés and restaurants with the latest machine technology, premium-quality ingredients, an integrated digital platform, and experienced experts.

Recognition as a global top-five distributor for several of the world's premium coffee machine brands is the natural result of consistently delivering on a commitment made from the very beginning: to be a partner that brings real value to every business it serves.

---

## Values

### 1. Uncompromising Quality
Every product we distribute goes through strict curation. Toffin only recommends the best for its customers' businesses.

### 2. Sustainable Partnership
Toffin positions itself as a business partner, not just a supplier. Every relationship is built on long-term trust and accountable results.

### 3. Certified Expertise
Toffin's technicians and baristas are officially certified by the international brands it distributes, guaranteeing service on par with global standards.

## Products & Services

### Coffee Machines & Equipment
- **Espresso Machines**: Official distribution of Victoria Arduino, Nuova Simonelli, SMEG, and other premium brands
- **Coffee Grinders**: Commercial grinders for cafés and roasteries
- **Other machines**: Brewing machines, milk frothers, and supporting F&B equipment

### F&B Ingredients
- Syrups, beverage powders, sachets, premixes
- Consumable supplies for the café & restaurant industry
- A strictly curated collection of premium ingredients

### Services
- Menu development consulting (Coffee Lab)
- Certified barista training
- Machine installation by certified technicians
- Regular servicing & maintenance (Maintenance Agreement Package / PMA)
- Official warranty throughout Indonesia
- Original spare parts

## Toffin App — B2B Digital Platform

**Status**: Product of the Year 2024 winner — Best Digital Platform in Indonesia's HORECA Industry

**Position**: The first B2B digital platform designed specifically for Indonesia's HORECA industry (not an adaptation of a generic app)

**Metrics**:
- 5,000+ active users
- 4.8/5 rating (App Store)
- 1,200+ product SKUs in the catalogue
- 24/7 access

**Platform**: iOS & Android
**Price**: Free to download
**Language**: Indonesian

### Key Features of Toffin App

1. **Personalized Order** — A personalised shopping feature with the best prices. Find world-class equipment at pre-agreed competitive prices.

2. **Artificial Intelligence Technology Recommendation** — Product recommendations tailored to your needs using AI technology. Easily see the products that suit your business.

3. **Service Credit Feature** — Easily purchase services such as barista training, or call a technician for machine maintenance or repair. A deposit-style feature (in rupiah) that can be topped up to buy products and services more economically.

4. **Interactive Feature** — Freely choose an expert or sales representative to talk to via live chat. Ask about products and specifications, or get a free consultation via chat or video call.

5. **Toffin Personal AI Assistant 2.0** — A personal assistant feature for consulting on anything in the F&B world, powered by GPT-4o.

6. **Easy Tracking** — Live tracking to follow your order's journey. Goods are shipped from the Toffin branch closest to your city.

7. **Warranty & Maintenance Service** — Shop with peace of mind, backed by maintenance and repair guarantees from Toffin Pakistan. Every product sold is guaranteed original and high quality.

8. **Toffin Points** — A loyalty points system. Every product purchase in Toffin App earns points that can be used on future transactions.

## Support & After-Sales

Toffin's after-sales service covers coffee machine installation, calibration, and servicing by a team of certified technicians. Official warranty, original spare parts, fast response in 19 cities.

### FAQ — After-Sales Service

**Q: How quickly does Toffin's after-sales service respond?**
A: Our technician team commits to responding to issue reports within a maximum of 24 hours in major cities (Jakarta, Semarang, Surabaya, Bali, Bandung, Medan, and Makassar), and within 48 hours in other cities. PMA customers receive faster priority response.

**Q: Are coffee machine spare parts available in Indonesia?**
A: Yes, Toffin keeps a stock of original spare parts for all the brands it distributes.

**Q: Does the machine warranty cover all of Indonesia?**
A: Yes, every machine and piece of equipment purchased through Toffin Pakistan is entitled to an official warranty valid across all 19 service cities. Contact the hotline to arrange the nearest technician for a warranty visit.

**Q: Is there a minimum charge for a technician call-out?**
A: For machines still under warranty, technician visits incur no additional charge. For machines out of warranty, a visit and diagnosis fee applies and will be communicated before the technician arrives. PMA customers are not charged visit fees.

**Q: Does Toffin service machines from brands it does not distribute?**
A: For the best service, we focus on officially distributed brands. However, for some brands common in the industry, consultation and referral to the right technician are available. Contact us to discuss further.

**Q: How do I sign up for a Maintenance Agreement Package (PMA)?**
A: Contact the sales team by phone, email, or the contact form. An account manager will reach out to survey the current condition of your machines and recommend the package best suited to the scale and needs of your business.

## Privacy Policy (Summary)

Toffin Pakistan complies with Law No. 27 of 2022 (the Personal Data Protection Law of the Republic of Indonesia).

### Data Collected
- Full name, business name, email, phone number (from the contact form)
- Web interaction data (cookies, IP address, browser info) via Google Analytics & Meta Pixel
- Content consumption (pages visited, traffic sources)

### Purposes of Use
- Responding to customer inquiries
- Sending relevant product information (with consent)
- Analytics to improve our services
- Personalising website content
- Data is not sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes

### User Rights (under the PDP Law)
- Right to access personal data
- Right to correct data
- Right to delete data
- Right to withdraw consent

**Data Protection Contact**: toffinpakistan@gmail.com (subject: "Privacy Request")

## Web Technology

- Platform: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript (vanilla, no framework)
- Hosting: Apache shared hosting (Rumahweb cPanel)
- Analytics: Google Tag Manager + Meta Pixel
- Form handler: EmailJS (client-side, no backend)
- Map: Google Maps JavaScript API (for the 19-branch map on /contact)
- Translator: Elfsight widget
- SEO: Full Schema.org JSON-LD (LocalBusiness + WebSite + BreadcrumbList + page-specific schemas)
